scope: Exact linear Gaussian pilot, not a novelty or four-system validation claim
selection_rule: Fit damping only by unweighted complex transfer relative L2 on training frequencies; never select using held-out tests
equilibrium_baseline_rule: Use original observed-coordinate damping gamma1 as a declared tie-break among identical stationary marginals
reference_rule: Two-state balanced truncation uses full known dynamics and is not information- or parameter-matched; exact memory reference is four-state-equivalent
uncertainty_rule: Deterministic exact response, no sampling confidence intervals; report numerical step refinement separately
